closing.summary: Big strengths are good volume for the calories, helps add volume without much calorie cost, and easy to build meals around, but the biggest weaknesses are low calcium, low vitamin A, and low protein quality. It is good for low-calorie volume, practical meals, and immune support because it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure, the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, and vitamin C gives the immune-support side a reason to exist.
